app.name: MediGuide AI
app.tagline: How urgently should you get medical help?

welcome.title: Describe your symptoms in your own words
welcome.intro: MediGuide reads a description in English, Telugu or Hindi, asks a few questions if needed, and tells you how urgently to seek medical care.
does: Checks for emergency warning signs first
Explains why it gave its recommendation
welcome.noAccount: No account needed. Your description is not stored unless you log in and choose to save it.
welcome.emergencyNow: If someone may be in danger right now, do not use this app. Call 112 or 108.

lang.title: Choose your language
lang.hint: You can describe symptoms in any of these languages. Results are shown in the language you choose.

auth.name: Name (optional)
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
auth.why: An account lets you save assessments and set your age and language once. It is optional.

assess.title: Describe your symptoms
assess.label: What are you feeling? Include how long and how bad, if you can.
assess.placeholder: e.g. I have had a severe headache for two days and I feel dizzy
assess.ageHint: Years. For babies use decimals, e.g. 0.5 = 6 months.
assess.save: Save this assessment to my history
assess.saveLogin: Log in to save assessments to your history.
assess.voiceHint: Your browser's speech service turns speech into text (it may send the audio to Google or Microsoft). Check the text before you submit.

followup.title: A few questions
followup.intro: These answers can change how urgent your situation is.
followup.nothingUnderstood: We could not recognise symptoms in your description.
followup.optional: You can leave a question blank if you are not sure.

result.title: Your result
result.denied: Symptoms you said you do not have
result.modelPath: How the decision tree reached its result
result.modelHint: The model learned from real emergency-department triage data. It can only raise urgency, never lower a warning sign.
result.noVoice: No voice for this language is installed on this device.
result.nearbyHint: opens Google Maps in a new tab

history.title: My saved assessments
history.empty: You have no saved assessments yet.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name
profile.why: Age and sex help the app avoid unnecessary questions. All fields are optional.
profile.confirmDeleteAccount: Delete your account and ALL saved assessments permanently?
profile.privacy: Your saved descriptions are encrypted. Anonymous usage counts (no names, no text) are kept to improve the service.

live.title: Recognised so far
live.none: No symptoms recognised yet. Keep typing.
live.emergency: Emergency warning sign recognised. Press “{{button}}” now, or call 112 / 108 if it is serious.
live.hint: Updates as you type. Nothing is saved.

summary.title: MediGuide AI: summary to show a doctor
summary.generated: Generated by an educational prototype. This is not a diagnosis.
